title: Bounded Embodiment lab signing key (v0.1)
description: One public signing key of a lab that submits Bounded Embodiment test reports. Reports are signed with Ed25519 over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the report without its signature member; a verifier looks the signature's kid up among these entries and never trusts a key carried inside a report. kid MUST equal the RFC 7638 thumbprint of public_jwk; this schema checks only its shape, and tools recompute it (bounded_embodiment.signing.check_key_entry). The entry holds no private key material: public_jwk rejects every member but kty, crv and x.

kid.description: RFC 7638 JWK thumbprint of public_jwk: SHA-256 over {"crv","kty","x"} in canonical JSON, base64url without padding (43 characters).

alg.description: Signature algorithm of the entries this key makes. v0.1 registers Ed25519 keys only.

x.description: The 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding (RFC 8037).

public_jwk.description: The public key as an RFC 8037 OKP JWK.

lab.description: Identifier of the lab that holds the key: lower-case letters, digits and inner hyphens, 1 to 64 characters, as used in the results repository path labs/<lab>/.

contact.description: Email address of the person responsible for the key.

added.description: UTC date the key was added, YYYY-MM-DD.

revoked.description: UTC date the key was revoked, YYYY-MM-DD, not earlier than added. Revoked keys are left out of verification keyrings by default.
